channel.title: Kubai Kevin
channel.description: Practical backend engineering, AI tooling, and developer career advice by Kubai Kevin — a software developer with 10+ years building production systems in fintech and AI.

item.title: Prompts are code: how to measure their value
item.description: Prompts and agent graphs need outcome metrics, not token counts. A practical guide to boundary instrumentation, versioning, and avoiding vanity metrics.

item.title: Zig vs Rust vs Go: compile errors compared
item.description: How Go, Rust, and Zig encode memory, concurrency, and correctness in compile errors, what each failure mode means, and how to fix it.

item.title: Flaky tests: reliability bug, not test noise
item.description: Flaky tests usually point to real non-determinism in production code. Learn to classify the four families, triage by blast radius, and fix the source.

item.title: Agent reliability: 7 metrics users trust
item.description: Seven agent reliability metrics that reflect user trust, how to compute each from existing logs, and which to instrument first.

item.title: Detecting silent agent failures
item.description: A layered quality gate that catches well-formed but wrong agent output: schema checks, PII scans, citation grounding, and a model judge, plus how to measure each.

item.title: Retire API versions before they pile up
item.description: Most API version graveyards come from shipping versions without a deletion plan. Here is how to make old versions cheap to measure, warn about, and remove.

item.title: Agent audit trails: event log vs state snapshots
item.description: Event sourcing and state snapshots solve different audit problems for AI agents. Compare causal reconstruction, debugging fidelity, cost, and replay limits.

item.title: Rate limiters: burst vs abuse, two designs
item.description: Two rate limiter designs compared: token bucket with concurrency cap versus sliding window with penalty box, plus how to tune and measure each.

item.title: Senior engineer: the bar moved, nobody updated the rubric
item.description: Seniority signals shifted from code production to specification, review and judgement. How to rewrite interview rubrics to measure the work that now exists.

item.title: 7 IDP shifts for AI feature delivery
item.description: Seven platform shifts that let teams version prompts, pin models, run offline evals, attribute token cost, and roll out AI changes gradually.

item.title: 7 bundling decisions that still matter
item.description: A practical review of seven bundling and code-splitting choices, their failure modes, and how to measure whether they help your app.

item.title: Self-service AI tooling: the permission trap
item.description: Design self-service LLM layers so identity, context and budget controls prevent quiet permission failures instead of only working on the happy path.

item.title: Promotions in the AI era: the mechanism
item.description: Why code volume stopped being a promotion signal, and how decision artifacts — ADRs, PR descriptions, instrumented tradeoffs — restore legible evidence of judgment.

item.title: Core Web Vitals: what actually moves the needle
item.description: A decision framework for Core Web Vitals: read field distributions, find fixed costs that hit the slow tail, and verify changes with segmented RUM.

item.title: Deployment platforms: senior vs new hire
item.description: How to build a deployment platform that serves both senior engineers and new hires, with escape hatches, guardrails, and a decision checklist.

item.title: Debugging techniques that outlast any framework
item.description: Framework-agnostic debugging methods: narrow hypotheses about state, time, concurrency, boundaries and data shape, with a worked race-condition example.

item.title: SLOs for agentic features: beyond latency
item.description: Define agent SLOs on task success, tool-call validity and clean termination, instrument them with OpenTelemetry, and alert on error-budget burn.

item.title: Cross-border fintech: why your KYC fails in Dakar
item.description: Why KYC validation breaks across borders, and how to replace per-country code forks with a policy layer, reachability checks, and locale-safe schemas.

item.title: Fraud detection: rules vs scoring, where they meet
item.description: How to split fraud decisions between a deterministic rules gate and a calibrated scoring model, with a worked three-layer architecture and audit trail.

item.title: AI best practices fail on slow networks
item.description: Why LLM best practices break on high-latency, metered mobile links, and how to design around a request budget of round trips and bytes instead.
